notes: New: language filter now supports selecting more than one language at once, e.g. Hindi and Gujarati together. Improved: category filter chips sit directly on screen now instead of behind a menu; Auto EQ now adapts bass response too, not just treble, and no longer adds treble brightness to already-harsh low-bitrate streams; Auto EQ also notices a music segment inside an otherwise-spoken podcast episode and adjusts for it. Fixed: selecting a language filter now matches a station's primary language only, not any language it merely mentions.
